_comment: Cards that exist only for the set_creature_types test (tests/unit/statics/test_set_creature_types.py). Never part of a deck list; loaded by the test registry fixture alongside data/cards/. `t_sct_reveler` is Goddric's Celebration shape on a legendary Human Noble; `t_sct_elk_curse` is the Kenrith's Transformation shape of type replacement and `t_sct_elk_mark` its creature-type line alone; `t_sct_sash` is a creature that is also an Equipment; `t_sct_idol` is a noncreature artifact carrying the static; `t_sct_spirit` is a plain creature to make arrive.
